compiled_state.description:
## Context
The generated configuration reference enumerates key, type, default, and lifecycle data from typed dataclass fields but provides no public setting descriptions. It cannot serve as the external settings contract until each emitted key explains its user-visible effect. F19 explicitly authorizes this Description-column enrichment as corrective follow-on scope beyond the closed generator baseline; generated ownership remains unchanged.

## Plan
- Add concise `public_description` metadata to every dataclass field emitted through `_SECTION_CLASSES`, co-located with each field so generator introspection remains the single source of truth and a sidecar description registry cannot drift.
- Treat `public_description` as the authoritative external setting prose; existing code comments remain internal implementation notes rather than a second generated contract.
- Preserve field types, defaults, factories, coercion, and runtime behavior.
- Extend `scripts/gen_config_reference.py` to require nonempty description metadata and render a Description column.
- Fail generation when an emitted field lacks a description.
- Regenerate `docs/config-reference.md`.
- Add focused tests for complete metadata, table escaping, generated drift, and an injected missing or empty description that fails with the offending key named.
- Review every generated Description cell against its key plus adjacent Type, Default, and Lifecycle cells; require a user-visible effect or operational consequence rather than a restatement, then record the reviewer identity, UTC timestamp, and completed row-by-row result in a ticket comment.
- Keep `src/rebar` modules below the absolute 800-line limit. Use an existing configuration-section seam if an extraction is required.

## Testing
- `python scripts/gen_config_reference.py --check`
- `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_gen_config_reference.py tests/unit/test_config_typed.py tests/unit/test_config_surface_golden.py -q`
- `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check && test $(wc -l < src/rebar/_config_schema.py) -le $(cat .github/module-size-limit.txt)`
- `make lint && make typecheck`
- Manual non-codebase proof: inspect every generated Description row against its Key, Type, Default, and Lifecycle cells; record reviewer identity, UTC timestamp, and the completed row-by-row result in a ticket comment.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Every generated typed key has one nonempty public description.
- [x] The injected missing or empty metadata test fails with the offending key named.
- [x] [non-codebase] Each description identifies a user-visible effect or operational consequence, attested by the named and timestamped row review.

- [x] [non-codebase] No description merely restates its row type, attested by the named and timestamped row review.

- [x] [non-codebase] No description merely restates its row lifecycle, attested by the named and timestamped row review.

- [x] Generated Markdown escapes table-sensitive content correctly.
- [x] Typed field annotations remain unchanged.
- [x] Default values remain unchanged.
- [x] Default factories remain unchanged.
- [x] Configuration coercion remains unchanged.
- [x] Configuration runtime behavior remains unchanged.
- [x] `_config_schema.py` remains within the absolute module-size limit.
- [x] Focused generator tests pass.
